req.title: Retrieve task by id
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /tasks/{task_id}. I design tests using EP (valid id returns 200 with correct payload), NEG (non-existent id returns 404, non-integer id returns 422), and BVA (boundary ids: id=1 lowest seeded row, id=20 highest seeded row, id=21 just beyond). Each test seeds the DB via the app's own POST endpoint or relies on pre-loaded fixture rows, asserts exact status codes and exact field values to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants. The in-process TestClient is used throughout; no live URLs.

tests.name: test_get_task_by_valid_id_returns_200_with_correct_payload
preconditions: Database contains task with id=1 (pre-loaded fixture row)
Task id=1 has title='Read chapter 5', completed=true
trace: R-TASK-008: system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r008_pos.db')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite:///./test_r008_pos.db', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = Session()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

created = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Read chapter 5', 'description': 'Signal pulse ember', 'completed': True})
assert created.status_code == 201
task_id = created.json()['id']

r = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert body['id'] == task_id
assert body['title'] == 'Read chapter 5'
assert body['completed'] == True
assert body['description'] == 'Signal pulse ember'
assert 'created_at' in body
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
